svg.title: Hashir Sakimdad, AI engineer. Portfolio source code.
svg.desc: Banner with the name Hashir Sakimdad and the role AI engineer. On the right, a neural network takes idea, data and caffeine as inputs; an activation wave flows through its layers, the output bars show ship it at about 95 percent, and the output card names a shipped product: Bharosa, Sukoon AI, then Saath AI.
